ProductListing.title: ProductListing
ProductListing.description: A student marketplace product listing synchronized to Firestore.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the student seller who owns this listing.

title.description: Title of the product listed for sale.

price.description: Price of the item in Naira (NGN).

description.description: Detailed description and condition notes for the product.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the product listing.

createdAt.description: Creation server timestamp (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Last update server timestamp (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/products/{productId}.description: Collection of student marketplace product listings.
